title: Learned Reporting Preferences in RLVR Can Conflict with the Current Request
abstract: arXiv:2609.36587v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a prominent approach for improving language-model performance on reasoning tasks using automatically checked answers. Yet convention-matched evaluation cannot reveal whether reinforcing one reporting convention reduces adherence to a different request that the initial policy already follows. To test this, we train matched policies under two reporting conventions and evaluate each policy under both current requests, using the same initial policy as a shared reference. We complement this crossed design with controlled interventions and independent human calibration. On GSM8K, boxed-format RLVR reduces the fraction of Qwen2.5-7B responses containing the requested hash-format payload by 35.33--74.37 percentage points relative to a 95.45% initial baseline in four of five training seeds; the fifth improves by 2.50 points. translated_title: RLVR中习得的报告偏好可能与当前请求相冲突
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.36587v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为一种重要方法，可利用自动核验的答案来提升语言模型在推理任务上的表现。然而，与训练约定相匹配的评估无法揭示：强化某一种报告约定是否会降低模型对初始策略本已遵循的另一类请求的遵从性。为检验这一点，我们在两种报告约定下分别训练匹配的策略，并在两种当前请求下评估每个策略，同时使用相同的初始策略作为共同参照。我们通过受控干预和独立的人工校准来补充这一交叉实验设计。在GSM8K上，在五个训练种子中的四个里，boxed格式的RLVR使Qwen2.5-7B响应中包含所请求的hash格式载荷的比例，相比95.45%的初始基线下降了35.33至74.37个百分点；第五个种子则提升了2.50个百分点。在这四个性能恶化的运行中，几乎所有相关响应（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究发现在RLVR训练中强化某一种报告格式（如boxed格式）会与初始策略已遵循的另一格式请求（如hash格式）发生冲突，导致Qwen2.5-7B在GSM8K上hash格式响应比例大幅下降35至74个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that RLVR training reinforcing one reporting convention (e.g., boxed format) can conflict with a different requested format (e.g., hash format) that the initial policy already follows, causing the hash-format response rate of Qwen2.5-7B on GSM8K to drop by 35 to 74 percentage points.
